quote: GIT and BLIP were fine-tuned for image-captioning separately on each of the different Impressions data types (description, perception, aesthetic evaluation).

We contribute the Impressions dataset, a multimodal benchmark that consists of 4,320 unique annotations over 1,440 image-caption pairs... Each annotation explores (1) the aesthetic impactfulness of a photograph, (2) image descriptions... (3) emotions/thoughts/beliefs... (4) the aesthetic elements that elicited the expressed impression.
This study presents a curated collection of image-caption data for training new systems that can understand connotation.
outputs: Free-form captions for image description, perception (impression), and aesthetic evaluation.
